<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function __toString(): string { return 'OWNER;'; }
    public function make() { return new class {}; }
};
$child = $owner->make(); $after = new class {};
echo (string)$owner, $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function make() { return new class {}; }
    public function __toString(): string { return 'OWNER;'; }
};
$child = $owner->make(); $after = new class {};
echo (string)$owner, $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
class R181Base {}
$owner = new class extends R181Base {
    public function make() { return new class {}; }
    public function __toString(): string { return 'OWNER;'; }
};
$child = $owner->make(); $after = new class {};
echo (string)$owner, $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function make() { return new class { public function inner() { return new class {}; } }; }
    public function __toString(): string { return 'OWNER;'; }
};
$child = $owner->make(); $grand = $child->inner(); $after = new class {};
echo (string)$owner, $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $grand::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public object $child;
    public function __construct() { $this->child = new class {}; echo 'CTOR;'; }
    public function __toString(): string { return 'OWNER;'; }
};
$after = new class {};
echo (string)$owner, $owner::class, ';', get_class($owner->child), ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function make() { return new class {}; }
    public function __toString(): int { return 1; }
};
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function make() { return new class { public function bad(int $x = 'bad') {} }; }
    public function __toString(): int { return 1; }
};
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function __toString(): int { return 1; }
    public function make() { return new class { public function bad(int $x = 'bad') {} }; }
};
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function uncalled() { return new class { public function bad(int $x = 'bad') {} }; }
    public function __toString(): string { return 'OWNER;'; }
};
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
class R181StringableBase implements Stringable { public function __toString(): string { return 'BASE;'; } }
$owner = new class extends R181StringableBase {
    public function make() { return new class {}; }
    public function __toString(): string { return 'OWNER;'; }
};
$child = $owner->make(); $after = new class {};
echo (string)$owner, $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function make() { return new class {}; }
    public function __toString() { return 'OWNER;'; }
};
$child = $owner->make(); $after = new class {};
echo (string)$owner, $owner instanceof Stringable ? 1 : 0, ';', $child instanceof Stringable ? 1 : 0, ';', $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function make() { return new class {}; }
    public function __toString(): string { return 'OWNER;'; }
};
class R181LaterBad { public static function __construct() {} }
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function make() { return new class { final private function alone() {} }; }
    public function __toString(): string { return 'OWNER;'; }
};
class R181LaterBadWarning { public static function __construct() {} }
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
class R181InheritedStringableBase implements Stringable { public function __toString(): string { return 'BASE;'; } }
$owner = new class extends R181InheritedStringableBase {
    public function make() { return new class {}; }
};
$child = $owner->make(); $after = new class {};
echo (string)$owner, $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$outer = new class {
    public function make() { return new class {
        public function inner() { return new class {}; }
        public function __toString(): string { return 'INNER;'; }
    }; }
    public function __toString(): string { return 'OUTER;'; }
};
$inner = $outer->make(); $grand = $inner->inner(); $after = new class {};
echo (string)$outer, (string)$inner, $outer::class, ';', $inner::class, ';', $grand::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function make() { return new class {}; }
    public function __ToStRiNg(): string { return 'CASE;'; }
};
$child = $owner->make(); $after = new class {};
echo (string)$owner, $owner instanceof Stringable ? 1 : 0, ';', $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';';
